# Translation Scripts

These Python scripts use Google Translate (via `deep_translator`) to translate `.qmd` files while preserving Quarto/Markdown syntax.

## Requirements

```bash
pip install deep-translator
```

## Available Scripts

| Script | Source | Target | Type |
|--------|--------|--------|------|
| `translate_to_catalan.py` | Spanish (es) | Catalan (ca) | Batch |
| `translate_to_english.py` | Spanish (es) | English (en) | Batch |
| `translate_to_spanish.py` | Catalan (ca) | Spanish (es) | Batch |
| `translate_to_english_from_catalan.py` | Catalan (ca) | English (en) | Batch |
| `translate_single_file.py` | Spanish (es) | Catalan (ca) | Single file |
| `translate_single_file_en.py` | Spanish (es) | English (en) | Single file |
| `translate_single_file_ca_to_es.py` | Catalan (ca) | Spanish (es) | Single file |
| `translate_single_file_ca_to_en.py` | Catalan (ca) | English (en) | Single file |

## Usage

### Batch Translation (all .qmd files in folder)

Run from the **target language folder**:

```bash
# Spanish to Catalan (run from ca/ folder)
cd ca/
python3.13 ../python_codes/translate_to_catalan.py

# Spanish to English (run from en/ folder)
cd en/
python3.13 ../python_codes/translate_to_english.py

# Catalan to Spanish (run from es/ folder)
cd es/
python3.13 ../python_codes/translate_to_spanish.py

# Catalan to English (run from en/ folder)
cd en/
python3.13 ../python_codes/translate_to_english_from_catalan.py
```

### Single File Translation

```bash
# Spanish to Catalan
python3.13 python_codes/translate_single_file.py ca/filename.qmd

# Spanish to English
python3.13 python_codes/translate_single_file_en.py en/filename.qmd

# Catalan to Spanish
python3.13 python_codes/translate_single_file_ca_to_es.py es/filename.qmd

# Catalan to English
python3.13 python_codes/translate_single_file_ca_to_en.py en/filename.qmd
```

Or from within the target folder:

```bash
cd es/
python3.13 ../python_codes/translate_single_file_ca_to_es.py competencias-ciencias.qmd
```

## What Gets Translated

- **YAML frontmatter**: `title`, `subtitle`, `description`, `categories`
- **Content**: Headers, paragraphs, lists, blockquotes, image alt text

## What Is Preserved (Not Translated)

- Code blocks (` ``` `)
- HTML tags
- Quarto shortcodes (`{{< ... >}}`)
- Quarto div syntax (`:::`)
- LaTeX equations (`$$`, `$...$`)
- URLs and file paths
- Markdown formatting (bold, italic, links)

## Notes

- Scripts translate files **in place** (overwrite the original)
- Files starting with `_` are skipped (e.g., `_quarto.yml`, `_website.yml`)
- Always review translations for accuracy, especially technical terms
